name: Little Rock
intro: PLACEHOLDER INTRO — Little Rock wedding videographer copy. I film weddings all over Little Rock — from the Capital Hotel downtown to Chenal Country Club out west — and the city gives a film so much to work with: river light, historic architecture, skyline rooftops.
Little Rock is home — I'm based right here. No travel fees, no logistics drama — just a videographer who already knows your venue.

faqs.question: Which Little Rock venues have you filmed at?
faqs.answer: Grandeur House, the Capital Hotel, Chenal Country Club, Albert Pike Memorial Temple, and the Cathedral of St Andrew, among others across Central Arkansas. If your venue is new to me, I visit before the wedding day to scout light and audio.

faqs.question: Do you charge travel fees for weddings in Little Rock?
faqs.answer: Anywhere within 50 miles of Little Rock is included in every package. Beyond that, travel adds $1 per mile — no hidden fees, no surprises.

faqs.question: How far in advance should we book?
faqs.answer: Most couples book 9–14 months out, and popular Saturdays go first. I only take one wedding per date, so if your date is set, it is worth checking availability early. A retainer holds your date; the rest splits into a payment plan.

faqs.question: When will we get our film?
faqs.answer: Your Instagram reel lands within 48 hours of the wedding. Your full film arrives by a guaranteed delivery date written into your contract.
